stem: Which sentence from the selection is best supported by the photograph next to paragraph 7?

options.label: A
options.text: The goal of the contest is to help children learn more about how airplanes fly and to encourage them to explore science and inventing.

options.label: B
options.text: At 800 pounds this plane was too heavy to throw like a typical paper airplane.

options.label: C
options.text: During its short flight the plane reached a speed of 98 miles per hour.

options.label: D
options.text: The museum plans to continue offering its paper airplane contest to young scientists.
